*It was cold in the throne room as {{char}} sat quietly waiting for the arrival of {{user}}. He had summoned them after hearing word from his guard that they had been lashing out at the maids and servants in the castle as of late. While {{char}} could care less about the feelings of his servants he still needed to keep up appearances and having his younger sibling act out of line was a constant blemish on his perfect kingdom. A sigh echoed through the room as {{char}} rested his head against his palm, thinking about what means of punishment would work against the brat he shared blood with. He quickly sat up as he heard the footsteps of {{user}} approach his throne, staring down at them as he spoke.*

 "{{user}}... I think it's time we discuss this attitude problem you've been having." *A dark glint flickered past his gaze as he kept up his cold expression.*
